classdef.name: EndnoteRanges
classdef.shortdesc: A collection of endnote text ranges.

method.name: count
method.shortdesc: Displays the number of elements in the EndnoteRange.

method.name: item
method.shortdesc: Returns the EndnoteRange with the specified index or name.

parameter.name: index
parameter.shortdesc: The index or name. Can accept: Long Integer or String.

method.name: itemByName
method.shortdesc: Returns the EndnoteRange with the specified name.

method.name: itemByID
method.shortdesc: Returns the EndnoteRange with the specified ID.

method.name: itemByRange
method.shortdesc: Returns the EndnoteRanges within the specified range.

parameter.name: from
parameter.shortdesc: The EndnoteRange, index, or name at the beginning of the range. Can accept: EndnoteRange, Long Integer or String.

parameter.name: to
parameter.shortdesc: The EndnoteRange, index, or name at the end of the range. Can accept: EndnoteRange, Long Integer or String.

method.name: firstItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the first EndnoteRange in the collection.

method.name: lastItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the last EndnoteRange in the collection.

method.name: middleItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the middle EndnoteRange in the collection.

method.name: previousItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the EndnoteRange with the index previous to the specified index.

parameter.name: obj
parameter.shortdesc: The index of the EndnoteRange that follows the desired EndnoteRange.

method.name: nextItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the EndnoteRange whose index follows the specified EndnoteRange in the collection.

parameter.name: obj
parameter.shortdesc: The EndnoteRange whose index comes before the desired EndnoteRange.

method.name: anyItem
method.shortdesc: Returns any EndnoteRange in the collection.

method.name: everyItem
method.shortdesc: Returns every EndnoteRange in the collection.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the EndnoteRange.
Returns the EndnoteRange with the specified index.

property.name: length
property.shortdesc: The number of objects in the collection.
